AuthoredNumericalRequirementsRow.description: A row or nested value projected from the registry declaration.

BackendSettings.description:
Typed backend settings of a request. Each variant is its adapter's pse-owned settings
type (`crate::settings`), present in every build, and identity derives from serde, never
from a hand-written field list (F09). The document form is tagged by the registry
`backend` spelling; the routed backend's native defaults have no document form, so a
document states them by omitting its settings. A backend this build does not link is
refused at admission, never at decoding.

oneOf.description: Ipopt linear solver with its parameters, barrier strategy and initial-point push.

bound_frac.description:
Minimum relative distance of a cold initial point from its bounds (`bound_frac`);
admission refuses more than one half, Ipopt's registered range.

bound_push.description: Minimum absolute distance of a cold initial point from its bounds (`bound_push`).

linear.description: Symmetric-indefinite factorization of the KKT systems.

restart.description: Restart of a submitted primal-dual seed: barrier and pushes (L-N3).

oneOf.title: IpoptSettings

oneOf.description: POUNCE method and complete native FERAL configuration.

restart.description: Interior-point restart of a submitted primal-dual seed (L-N3).

oneOf.title: PounceSettings

oneOf.description: KINSOL method controls; scales and the step tolerance derive from policy.

anderson.description: Native Anderson history; zero disables acceleration.

anderson_delay.description: Iterations before Anderson acceleration starts (`KINSetDelayAA`); Anderson only.

eta.description: Inexact-Newton forcing term; Krylov routes only.

linear.description: Native linear solver for equation profiles.

max_newton_step.description:
Maximum scaled Newton step (`KINSetMaxNewtonStep`), at least one scaled unit
because KINSOL raises a smaller cap to one; `None` keeps KINSOL's
`1000 * ||D_u u_0||`.

orthogonalization.description: Anderson QR orthogonalization; Anderson acceleration only.

preconditioner.description:
Krylov preconditioner from the analytic Jacobian (`KINSetPreconditioner`);
KINSOL preconditions on the right.

setup_interval.description: Maximum nonlinear iterations between linear setups.

oneOf.title: KinsolSettings

oneOf.description: HiGHS method, opt-in diagnostics and partial MIP start.

diagnostics.description: Opt-in native work, separate from the original candidate.

method.description: Eligible LP algorithm; mixed models retain native class routing.

nodes.description:
MIP node budget, separate from the iteration budget (F10). `None` leaves the native
default (no node limit), so the time limit alone bounds the search.

sparse_start.description: Partial source-attributed MIP start, with unspecified coordinates absent.

oneOf.title: HighsSettings

oneOf.description: The pse-owned Clarabel settings: mode and every admitted native control.

chordal_decomposition_complete_dual.description: Complete the dual of decomposed PSD cones.

chordal_decomposition_enable.description:
Chordal decomposition of PSD cones; `ReusableData` disables it. Without the SDP
profile only the chordal defaults are admitted.

input_sparse_dropzeros.description: Drop explicit input zeros; `ReusableData` disables it.

min_switch_step_length.description: Minimum step length before switching to symmetric scaling.

oneOf.title: ClarabelSettings

oneOf.description: SCIP's nested Ipopt linear solver, seed and node budget.

exact.description:
Exact rational MILP (`SCIPenableExactSolving`); admitted for linear programs
without native forms, and never with reoptimization or concurrency.

iis.description:
After a proof of infeasibility, compute an irreducible infeasible subsystem of the
true exported program (`SCIPgenerateIIS`).

nlp_linear_solver.description:
Linear solver of the nested Ipopt (`nlpi/ipopt/linear_solver`): the image's one
Ipopt, so the same type the Ipopt adapter's settings select.

nodes.description:
Total branch-and-bound node budget including restarts (`limits/totalnodes`);
absent leaves the deadline as the only budget.

pool.description: Number of ranked stored solutions reported beside the candidate (0: none).

reoptimize.description:
Retain the native search tree across a finite MIP sequence whose constraint system
is unchanged and whose linear objective changes (`SCIPenableReoptimization`).

seed.description: Random seed shift (`randomization/randomseedshift`), recorded with the result.

oneOf.title: ScipSettings

FiniteBound.description: A finite real of either sign: a bound, a weight or a stated value.

Fraction.description: A finite fraction in (0, 1]: a damping factor, a step fraction or a relative push.

HighsDiagnostics.description: Requested native diagnostic work, bounded by the original attempt's deadline.

basis_inverse.description:
Rows of the basis inverse `B⁻¹` at these basis positions, with the basic variables,
for an optimal continuous LP with a valid basis.

cut_pool.description: The MIP solver's cut pool after root cut generation (callback kind 7).

fixed_lp.description:
Duals of the MIP's LP with its discrete columns fixed at the solution
(`Highs_getFixedLp`), conditional on that commitment.

iis.description: Native irreducible infeasible subsystem; MIP scope is its LP relaxation.

presolve.description:
Native presolve of a copied model: the presolved LP and, for a continuous LP, the
postsolved solution of that LP.

ranging.description: Basis sensitivity ranges for an optimal continuous LP with a valid basis.

rays.description: Native primal/dual rays when available for the continuous model.

relaxation.description:
Separate feasibility-relaxation solve on a copied LP/MIP. Negative penalties
forbid violation, as in the native API; no penalty is inferred from units.

HighsPenalties.description: Complete physical penalty declarations for native feasibility relaxation.

global.description: Global lower-bound, upper-bound and constraint penalties.

IpoptLinear.description:
One linked symmetric-indefinite factorization with its typed parameters. HSL solvers and
the runtime-loaded Pardiso are not representable (ADR-0108 item 9). Each kind is spelled
as its [`IpoptLinearSolver`], Ipopt's native `linear_solver` name.

oneOf.description: Sequential MUMPS 5.9 (`linear_solver = mumps`).
SPRAL SSIDS on OpenMP threads (`linear_solver = spral`).

oneMKL Pardiso on MKL threads (`linear_solver = pardisomkl`), under the pinned CBWR
branch.

JobStart.description: How a job's solve is started.

oneOf.description: From the case's authored starts.
From the latest incumbent in the parent attempt chain (Plan 22 G8).
From one stored solution (Plan 22 G8).

KinsolEta.description: Inexact-Newton forcing term of the Krylov routes (`KINSetEtaForm`).

oneOf.description: Eisenstat-Walker choice 1, KINSOL's default.
Eisenstat-Walker choice 2 (`KINSetEtaParams`).
A constant forcing term in (0, 1] (`KINSetEtaConstValue`).

KinsolLinear.description:
Selected native linear algebra. Dense allocation has an explicit dimension ceiling;
the matrix-free Krylov routes use the analytic Jacobian-vector product.

oneOf.description: Vendored SuiteSparse KLU with analytic CSC Jacobian.
Serial dense factorization for explicitly small systems.
Matrix-free native GMRES.
Matrix-free native flexible GMRES.
Matrix-free native BiCGStab.
Matrix-free native transpose-free QMR.

KktTolerances.description: Distinct normalized optimality requirements; no scalar means every stopping test.

NumericalPolicy.description: Shared semantic controls resolved before invoking any native adapter.

closure.description: Physical acceptance, separate from native termination.

gap_absolute.description: Absolute continuous optimality gap in normalized objective coordinates.

integrality.description: Integer-lattice violation budget in original variable coordinates.

mip_absolute_gap.description: Absolute gap in normalized objective coordinates.

native_scaling.description: Permit native algorithmic scaling after model normalization.

requirements.description: ID-keyed analysis overrides, using the same declaration as model/case sources.

strict_nominals.description: Refuse canonical-unit fallback where no authored or quantity nominal is known.

OptionValue.description:
Native option type; each adapter validates registration, type and protected controls.
A document states the value itself: a JSON Boolean, integer, other number or string
decodes as the Boolean, integer, real or text option of that value.

PositiveCount.description: A strictly positive count: a dimension, a thread count or an iteration budget.

RestartBarrier.description: The initial barrier parameter of an interior-point restart.

oneOf.description:
The final barrier value the producing interior-point solve recorded with the seed. A
seed without one (an authored seed) leaves the native default in force, and the
receipt says so.
A stated positive value.

SolveControls.description:
Finite shared attempt controls chosen by the caller; solver-specific settings remain
native typed values. Accuracy is not among them: it is resolved from the numerical
policy ([`ResolvedAccuracy`]). A document states the time limit in seconds; absent
fields take these defaults and unknown fields are refused.

hessian.description: Hessian representation for compatible NLP methods.

history.description: Bounded retained progress and failure events.

options.description: Additional native options, admitted by the selected adapter.

start.description: Numerical start policy, independent of native allocation reuse.

time_limit.description: Positive wall-clock allowance, including callbacks, in seconds.

SolveSettings.description:
The settings of one solve. The version is required; every other field takes the
default of [`SolverProfile::default`] when absent.

backend.description: An explicitly selected eligible backend; absent is deterministic routing.

convexity_absolute.description:
Absolute eigenvalue budget of a numerical convexity assessment; with the relative
budget, it permits numerical assessment, and absent both, only exact certification.

convexity_relative.description: Relative eigenvalue budget of a numerical convexity assessment.

numerics.description: ID-keyed numerical requirements and acceptance budgets.

presolve_options.description: Native presolve options; an explicit policy only.

required_passes.description: Passes that may not silently become unavailable; an explicit policy only.

settings.description: Typed settings of one backend; absent is the routed backend's native defaults.

Tolerance.description: A finite, strictly positive tolerance, budget or push.

WarmRestart.description:
How an interior-point method re-centres a complete primal-dual seed (L-N3). With the
cold-start defaults a seeded restart is pushed back towards the analytic centre and loses
most of its benefit, so a restart states its barrier and its pushes. Absent fields take
these defaults across the Python boundary (ADR-0113).

barrier.description: Initial barrier parameter of the restart (`mu_init`).

bound_frac.description:
Relative push of the primal seed from its bounds (`warm_start_bound_frac`); at most
one half.

bound_push.description: Absolute push of the primal seed from its bounds (`warm_start_bound_push`).

mult_bound_push.description: Push of the bound multipliers from zero (`warm_start_mult_bound_push`).

slack_bound_frac.description:
Relative push of the slack seed from its bounds (`warm_start_slack_bound_frac`); at
most one half.

slack_bound_push.description: Absolute push of the slack seed from its bounds (`warm_start_slack_bound_push`).

description:
Version 2 of a modeling job: one authored case of a package closure, solved once under
typed solve settings. Unknown fields and versions are refused.

modeling.description: The source bundles of the modeling package closure, in load order.

physical.description: The source bundle of the physical package.
